snippet.title: My Helpers | Announcement Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. FIND THEM by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

Minimum:
OS: Windows 10
Memory: 4 GB RAM
